title: Promotions Bulletin: Renewal-Season Multiplier for Residential Electricity Supply Referral Credits
content:
Promotions bulletin, Residential Electricity Supply. Referral credits posted while the referring customer's own contract is close to its renewal are scaled up.

**Rule.** The renewal season is read from the latest renewal notice on the referring agreement, whose stated contract end date stays as printed whatever renewal or plan change the agreement records. When that stated end date is 1 to 60 calendar days after the posting date, the plan referral credit is multiplied by the near-renewal season factor of 1.25; when it is 61 to 180 calendar days after, by the approaching-renewal season factor of 1.10; when it is further away, already passed, or the referring agreement has no renewal notice, the plan referral credit is taken as it stands.

**Which notice and which date.** The latest renewal notice is the one with the latest notice date, of either kind (initial renewal notice or final options notice). Its stated end date is the contract end date printed on that notice, not the contract end date now recorded on the agreement. The days are that stated end date less the posting date, in calendar days.

| Stated end date relative to the posting date | Plan referral credit |
|---|---|
| 1 to 60 days after | multiplied by 1.25 |
| 61 to 180 days after | multiplied by 1.10 |
| 181 days or more after | taken as it stands |
| on the posting date itself, or before it | taken as it stands |
| no renewal notice on the referring agreement | taken as it stands |

**Boundaries (hypothetical posting date 2026-03-01).** A stated end date of 2026-04-30 is 60 days after and takes 1.25; 2026-05-01 is 61 days after and takes 1.10; 2026-08-28 is 180 days after and takes 1.10; 2026-08-29 is 181 days after and is taken as it stands.

**Example (hypothetical).** A plan referral credit of 50.00 USD with a stated end date 45 days after the posting date becomes 62.50 USD.
